paragraphs: Mia took a photo at the school sports morning on Monday. Lily put the photo on Explorers' Blog. The photo shows the school field in the morning sun. Many children are on the grass. Under the photo, Lily wrote a game for you. "Can you find three people in the photo? Read about each person, and then look for him or her."

"Person one is a tall man. He has short black hair and a red shirt. The shirt has a white stripe on it. A silver whistle is over his shirt. His shorts are black, and he stands next to the football goal. He looks at the children and smiles.

"Person two is a boy in a striped shirt. The shirt is blue and white, and it has a pocket on the front. He holds a large red ball in his hands. A green bandage is on his knee. He stands under the tree on the right. He has a white towel on his shoulder. His hair is short and black, and he looks at the girl.

"Person three is a girl with long black hair. She wears a white hat and a yellow T-shirt. Her white shoes have a green toe. Her shorts are white. There is a small yellow bag next to her. She sits on the grass in front of the tree. Can you see her?"

Leo read the post after lunch. "I found all three!" he said. "Person one is Coach Matt, because I can see his whistle." "Good!" said Mia. "Which person was the easy one?" asked Lily. "The man, because of his red shirt," said Leo. "The girl is my friend, and I took the photo before her race," said Mia. Lily smiled and wrote a new line under the game. "Now it is your turn to look!"
